tweetHighlights.originalBody:
Safari 27 supports JSPI, a magic WebAssembly capability for sync native code to suspend on an async 𝙿𝚛𝚘𝚖𝚒𝚜𝚎.

On https://t.co/OL0LzGtvAw, libfx uses the built-in browser 𝚏𝚎𝚝𝚌𝚑 stack to make API calls.

As more code goes native, I expect WebAssembly to play a huge role in the future of the web.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: Safari 27 支持 JSPI，这是一种神奇的 WebAssembly 功能，可将本地代码同步到 sus…
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
Safari 27 支持 JSPI，这是 WebAssembly 的一项神奇功能，它允许同步原生代码在异步请求时暂停执行。

在 https://t.co/OL0LzGtvAw 中，libfx 使用浏览器内置的 tfs 堆栈进行 API 调用。

随着越来越多的代码采用原生代码，我预计 WebAssembly 将在 Web 的未来发展中扮演至关重要的角色。

tweetHighlights.summary: Aaron Levie 的最新观点聚焦在可执行的一线经验，命中主题 Coding Agents / Foundation Models：There’s a massive chasm between the power of AI models and the ultimate workflows that enterprises are trying to auto…
tweetHighlights.whyItMatters: 这条文字动态直接覆盖你的关注主题：Coding Agents、Foundation Models。
tweetHighlights.originalTitle: There’s a massive chasm between the power of AI models and the ultimate workflows t…
tweetHighlights.originalBody:
There’s a massive chasm between the power of AI models and the ultimate workflows that enterprises are trying to automate. This gap is the opportunity for the applied AI layer to fill. 

You need to connect the intelligence to workflows, often reengineer processes, aggregate the right context and data, allow for the right human in the loop experiences, drive change management, do domain specific evals, manage the security and governance of the data and process, and much more.

We’re going to see this layer emerge in every vertical and horizontal category. And ironically, even as models improve at incredible rates, this layer still must exist - and may become even more important and useful. Greater capability enables even more complex tasks to be tackled, amplifying the challenges if you don’t do this well.

Was super fun chatting with @sonyatweetybird on all the things going into AI diffusion.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 人工智能模型的能力与最终的工作流程之间存在着巨大的鸿沟……
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
人工智能模型的强大功能与企业试图自动化的最终工作流程之间存在着巨大的鸿沟。而应用型人工智能层正可以填补这一空白。

你需要将智能与工作流程连接起来，通常需要对流程进行重构，聚合正确的上下文和数据，实现合适的人机交互体验，推动变革管理，进行特定领域的评估，管理数据和流程的安全性和治理，等等。

我们将看到这一层出现在各个垂直和水平领域。具有讽刺意味的是，即使模型以惊人的速度改进，这一层仍然必不可少——而且可能会变得更加重要和有用。更强大的能力能够处理更复杂的任务，但如果你处理不好这一层，挑战也会随之加剧。

和 @sonyatweetybird 聊人工智能普及的方方面面真是太有趣了。

tweetHighlights.originalBody:
I was not expecting things to go this way, but I think MCPs are better than CLIs for most integrations. 

The models have gotten much better at tool calling, we can defer tools & MCP is now stateless.

If you need to compose/filter data, add params like query to your MCP tools.
tweetHighlights.translatedTitle: 我没想到事情会这样发展，但我认为 MCP 比 CLI 更适合……
tweetHighlights.translatedBody:
我没想到事情会这样发展，但我认为对于大多数集成而言，MCP 比 CLI 更胜一筹。

模型在工具调用方面有了很大的改进，我们可以延迟工具的调用，而且 MCP 现在是无状态的。

如果您需要组合/筛选数据，请向 MCP 工具添加类似查询的参数。
